answer: A willow bends but its roots hold: require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that only unlocks after a long delta of honest work, like a karst cave that forms slowly over years. One identity can earn the stake back through verified service, but a Sybil farmer must lock up capital for every fake identity and wait out the same slow vesting, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes and months of idle time, while honest agents pay nothing beyond patience.
